29c44a1b8bed96c51db5bf78 description: Come on in, have a seat. Need a ride? A boat, you say, to reach a ship out in the gulf. Nah man. I barely got this BTR back on its feet, no time for boats. But I know someone. Picked up some parts from smugglers before, they've got all kinds of junk lying around. Might have something that floats too. They don't usually deal with your kind, but I can ask around. Relax man, I'll be heading that way anyway. Although you could do something to improve your chances. They've got a stash where too many outsiders have been showing up lately. You clear out those guests, I'll let the smugglers know it was you who helped. It's north of the port terminal, around where the health resort is. Go down from the resort toward customs, there's a big open field. Past that you'll see a few hangars with shipping containers. By the time you're done and back, I'll have info for you.
29c44a1b8bed96c51db5bf78 startedMessageT: The camp sits past the field below the resort, hangars and shipping containers. Clear the guests out.
29c44a1b8bed96c51db5bf78 successMessageT: They will not screw you on the insertion, do not worry. When you are ready, head to the shore, find the hovercraft, and bring cash. Getting back off that ship is your own problem.
29c44a1b8bed96c51db5bf78 failMessageText: The camp is still crawling with guests. Smugglers won't talk to you like this.

e857e9c34949ecbf1cf5a5b2 description:
I already told you everything in the car. But if you really wanna get the smugglers to put in a more comfortable transport option to Icebreaker, you'll need to help them out with their fight against the Rogues first.

Looks like things between them are pretty serious, and honestly I have no idea where it's going worst. So you can take initiative anywhere you want, just make sure there are fewer Rogue fighters left. Otherwise the smugglers won't even listen to you, they've got bigger problems right now.
e857e9c34949ecbf1cf5a5b2 startedMessageT: Thin them out wherever you find them. The smugglers will hear about it.
e857e9c34949ecbf1cf5a5b2 successMessageT: That's a dent in them, alright. I'll pass the word along, they should be a lot more talkative now.
e857e9c34949ecbf1cf5a5b2 failMessageText: The Rogues are still all over them. Nobody's rearranging anything for you yet.
8b2b4eea617e2be2e54df123 description:
You did pretty well helping with the Rogues, and the smugglers actually came to me themselves. One of their commanders is being held by those bastards over at the water treatment plant, and the guys want to get their own man back.

But for that, they need a reliable route from Priozersk to the Rogue base. If you help with that, maybe we can talk about your request too. You'll need to go along the path from the nature reserve to the lighthouse and mark the start and end of the route.
8b2b4eea617e2be2e54df123 startedMessageT: Walk it yourself, start to finish. Strobes on both ends so they know it was actually checked.
8b2b4eea617e2be2e54df123 successMessageT: Route's logged. The guys can move on their commander now, and they'll remember who cleared it for them.
8b2b4eea617e2be2e54df123 failMessageText: Route's still a blank spot. Nobody's moving on anything.

c7a1f0b93e64d5827ab1cc40 description: Alright, well the smugglers managed to get their commander out, though not without losses. I'm heading over to talk things through and ask about you as well. But you get it, right now they need to both celebrate the win and properly remember the ones they lost. So I can't show up empty-handed. You gonna help set the table?
c7a1f0b93e64d5827ab1cc40 successMessageT: That's a decent haul of grub you brought. With stuff like this, the conversation will go a lot easier. By the next time we meet, I should have something for you about your request.
c7a1f0b93e64d5827ab1cc40 failMessageText: I'm showing up empty-handed then. Thanks for nothing.
3f8d2c5a9b17e04d6ca8f312 description: I went over to the guys, we had a real good talk... When you're ready, just come see me and I'll tell you everything, uh... In person!
3f8d2c5a9b17e04d6ca8f312 startedMessageT: Come find me when you want to hear it.
3f8d2c5a9b17e04d6ca8f312 successMessageT: The smugglers are ready to help you, but not for free. So if you're ready to pay, we can get you to Icebreaker straight from your little basement. Just give me a heads-up in advance, alright?
3f8d2c5a9b17e04d6ca8f312 failMessageText: Suit yourself. The offer was on the table.
